step1_analysis.circuit_type: Fully Differential Amplifier / Limiting Driver Stage
step1_analysis.description: A fully differential amplifier stage used as a building block in a distributed limiting driver. It features a main differential pair (XM2, XM5) for signal amplification and an auxiliary pair (XM1, XM6) intended for DC offset control, though its tail current source (XM4) is disabled (gate tied to VSS) in this specific netlist extraction.

paper_reference.title: A 3-V Fully Differential Distributed Limiting Driver for 40-Gb/s Optical Transmission Systems

paper_reported.value: 10 dB (Return Loss), High Gain for Limiting

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rload. Assuming W=100u, L=0.15u, VOA=0.8V -> Id_tail ≈ 13mA. gm ≈ 48mS per side. With 50 ohm loads, Gain = 48mS * 50 = 2.4 V/V = 7.6 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V CMOS. The gain depends heavily on the chosen W/L and bias current to drive the 50-ohm loads.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the output RC time constant. R=50 ohms, C_out ~ 100fF. f3dB = 1 / (2*pi*50*100f) ≈ 31 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 130nm CMOS is slower than the original process, but with 50-ohm loads, the bandwidth is RC-limited and can still reach >10 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Tail current * Rload. 13mA * 50 ohms = 0.65V single-ended swing, 1.3V differential swing.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the 1.8V supply and available tail current in SKY130 without exceeding device limits.

power_dissipation.description: Total DC power consumption of the stage

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on the required tail current to drive 50-ohm loads with reasonable gain.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure differential gain, bandwidth, transient swing, and power dissipation of the driver stage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Differential Driver Stage
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameterized W/L for high-speed 50-ohm driving capability
.param W_xm1=100u L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=100u L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=100u L_xm3=0.15u
.param W_xm4=100u L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=100u L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=100u L_xm6=0.15u

* DUT
XM1 OUTP DCAP N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUTP DINN N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 VOA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 VSS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUTN DINP N2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUTN DCAN N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Power Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0

* Load resistors (50 ohms as per distributed amplifier architecture)
R1 VDD OUTP 50
R2 VDD OUTN 50

* Bias voltages
VVOA VOA 0 0.8
VDCAP DCAP 0 0.9
VDCAN DCAN 0 0.9

* Input signals (AC magnitude 0.5 each side -> 1.0V differential)
VDINP DINP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.2 10G)
VDINN DINN 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 180 SIN(0.9 -0.2 10G)

* Voltage controlled voltage source to calculate differential output
E_diff VDIFF 0 OUTP OUTN 1.0

.control
  * 1. DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * 2. AC Analysis (Gain and Bandwidth)
  ac dec 50 1Meg 100G
  let gain_db = vdb(VDIFF)
  meas ac max_gain max gain_db
  let f3db_target = max_gain - 3
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=f3db_target fall=1

  * 3. Transient Analysis (Output Swing at 10 GHz)
  tran 1p 500p
  meas tran swing_max max v(VDIFF)
  meas tran swing_min min v(VDIFF)
  let swing_pp = swing_max - swing_min
  print swing_pp

  quit
.endc
